purpose: Larger factorized spatiotemporal Transformer; implementation only, not yet trained
inputs: 5x5 ordered neighborhood, daily Terra/Aqua counts FRP daytime counts, target month plus3days each side; source support/outage masks; relative day and cyclic day-of-year; multiscale Fourier absolute location and relative offsets/distance; local rich monthly MODIS features;5component training-only MODIS seasonal reference
seasonal_reference: For each cell and calendar month: mean/std log1p count, positive frequency, mean log1p FRP, log1p number of years. Exclude the entire example year when it is among fitted years. No VIIRS climatology or future-year reference.
target: Expected retained monthly SNPP VIIRS count per0.5degree CA cell
training: AdamW .0003, weight decay.01, cosine floor5%, clip1, up to600epochs, validation every5epochs, patience60epochs; duration chosen only by2019-2020 monthly MAE, final refit for selected duration
loss: Conditional positive-count deviance weighted1/sqrt(y+1), binary presence BCE, log1p count smoothL1; no direct aggregate loss in this version
limits: Retrospective symmetric context, not causal forecasting. Daily context available2012-2025 only; no pre2012 backcast claim. Source masks are not cloud/overpass exposure. Context geography follows cached western-state union, monthly targets remain state-clipped. All audit periods previously inspected. No promotion or training performed during implementation.
